title: 8-Bit Texture Pack
description: This project turns your game into 8-Bit textures instead of 16-Bit!
body:
This project turns all of your items, and eventually blocks, into 8-Bit textures for those that want it! Note that this resource pack is in development and does not contain everything in 8-Bit textures yet.
